additional_info.subject: Status Update
additional_info.body:
Issue seems to be related to Power Converter
2102312VGQKXNB001280
, which seem to switch off all the other converters.
OGC feedback is lost, and this could be just a consequence.
R&D Ticket created to support investigation: EMOB-20914
To understand if replacing Power converter could be the solution or not.
RC informed to prepare to go onsite with #1 power converter and #1 State Monitor KF13.

additional_info.subject: ID0461367-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002564] Log Check CRM:03056000485
additional_info.body:
Hi Giuseppe, good morning.
As we aligned yesterday, since there is still someone to be assigned to the R&D ticket and it might take 1 week at least to get feedback, we would recommend you to go there and check the converter that is not working:
2102312VGQKXNB001280
And the StateMonitor.
I would first try to remove the converter and try a session, if it works, we have a culprit. Place the new one and confirm if everything is working fine.
If it's still not working, then we can try the new StateMonitor.
Let me know what you think and when you can go to site, so that we can support remotely. We will keep the ticket since it's under investigation from R&D but we should go there as soon as we can since the DC2 is not working at all due to this problem.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
